description:
Domain India lets customers manage their domains, hosting, business email, websites and apps by asking in plain language instead of clicking through a control panel.

Connect your Domain India account to ask things like when your domains expire, whether you have unpaid invoices, whether your business email is set up correctly, or whether your app is running. Answers are read live from your own account.

Most permissions are view only. With your permission, it can also open or reply to a support ticket, or restart or start one of your own App Platform apps. Every permission is chosen by you when you connect, and you can disconnect at any time from the Connected apps page in your Domain India client area.

There is deliberately no permission for payments, domain transfer (EPP) codes, nameserver or contact changes, passwords, or cancelling or deleting any service. Those actions do not exist in this app, so it can never be asked to perform them.

Sign-in uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE: your Domain India password is never shared with ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Which Domain India account am I connected to, and what are you allowed to do?
Give me an overview of my Domain India account.?
What domains do I have and when do they expire?
